note: Spatial association only: assets located near a traced river. Not damage, not impact, not a forecast.

population.label: Population within corridor
population.method: Each raster cell assigned to at most one reach; cells within 2000 m of the reach summed
population.caveats: Modelled estimate, not a census; cells near reach joins go to one reach only; indicative, not exact

osm_place_city_town.label: Cities/towns (OSM place nodes)
osm_place_city_town.method: Feature (centroid) assigned to the nearest reach within 2000 m
osm_place_city_town.caveats: Crowd-sourced; mountain areas are often under-mapped so a zero can mean 'not mapped'. Segments, not kilometres.
